author: bogu
title: M340 - BMXAMI0810 showing IO error
op_text: Within the rack, no wired IO connected, I'm getting an IO error on the channel 0 to 4. Swap with another card I get the same thing. I've turned off the AI channels 0 to 4 and the error persists. Channels 5 to 7 have no issue. Swapping BMXAMI0810, the error on channel 0 to 4 remains, regardless of card. So this means its something I've done, but what?
technician_version: I have a Schneider Electric Modicon M340 rack with a BMXAMI0810 8-channel analog input module that shows an I/O error on channels 0 through 4, even with nothing wired to the terminals. Channels 5 to 7 are fine. I swapped in a different BMXAMI0810 and got the exact same error on channels 0 to 4, and disabling those channels in the configuration did not clear it. Since it follows the slot and not the card, what in my configuration or setup would cause channels 0 to 4 to fault, and how do I clear it?
oem_model_fault: Schneider Electric Modicon M340 BMXAMI0810 analog input — I/O error on channels 0-4 with no wiring; persists across card swap and with channels disabled; channels 5-7 OK
